opening.argument: The description introduces the Ethereum Economic Zone as a framework for synchronously composable rollups and lists one deployment, shared liquidity, and transactions across L1 and L2. The video is framed as a technical or promotional introduction that also discusses identity and smart wallets. Its invitation to learn more continues that introduction. Nothing in the cited material connects the shared-liquidity language or the link to an investment promise, mandatory participation, required payment, or data submission. Nor does it establish a harmful outcome.

citations.quote: Welcome to the Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ), a framework for synchronously composable rollups.
One deployment. Shared liquidity. Single transactions across L1 & L2.
